{{nihongo|'''Hiruko Shrine'''|蛭子神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

'''Hiruko Shrine''' (ひるこじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Naka, Tokushima|Q1205685|qid=Q1205685}}, {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|Q160734|qid=Q160734}}. It is one of the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Washiki Seven Lucky Gods}} ({{ill|Ebisu (mythology)|Q1129330|qid=Q1129330|lt=Ebisu Ōkami}}).

Later it was rebuilt in {{ill|1601|ab|1601|af|1601|als|1601|am|1601 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1601|ar|1601|ary|1601|arz|1601|ast|1601|avk|1601|az|1601|azb|۱۶۰۱ (میلادی)|ban|1601|bar|1601|bcl|1601|be|1601|be_x_old|1601|bg|1601|bn|১৬০১|bpy|মারি ১৬০১|br|1601|bs|1601.|ca|1601|cdo|1601 nièng|ceb|1601|ckb|١٦٠١|crh|1601|cs|1601|csb|1601|cv|1601|cy|1601|da|1601|de|1601|diq|1601|el|1601|eml|1601|eo|1601|es|1601|et|1601|eu|1601|fa|۱۶۰۱ (میلادی)|fi|1601|fo|1601|fr|1601|frr|1601|fur|1601|fy|1601|ga|1601|gan|1601年|gcr|1601|gd|1601|gl|1601|gv|1601|he|1601|hi|१६०१|hr|1601.|ht|1601 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1601|hy|1601|hyw|1601 թուական|ia|1601|id|1601|ilo|1601|io|1601|is|1601|it|1601|ja|1601年|jv|1601|ka|1601|kaa|1601|kk|1601 жыл|kn|೧೬೦೧|ko|1601년|krc|1601 джыл|la|1601|lb|1601|lez|1601 йис|li|1601|lij|1601|lmo|1601|lt|1601 m.|lv|1601. gads|mai|१६०१|map_bms|1601|mdf|1601|mg|1601|mhr|1601|mi|1601|mk|1601|mr|इ.स. १६०१|mrj|1601 и|ms|1601|my|၁၆၀၁|myv|1601 ие|mzn|۱۶۰۱|nah|1601|nap|1601|nds|1601|new|सन् १६०१|nl|1601|nn|1601|no|1601|nrm|1601|nso|1601|oc|1601|olo|1601|or|୧୬୦୧|os|1601-æм аз|pl|1601|pnb|1601|pt|1601|qu|1601|ro|1601|ru|1601 год|rue|1601|sa|१६०१|sah|1601|scn|1601|sd|1601ع|se|1601|sh|1601.|shn|1601|simple|1601|sk|1601|sl|1601|smn|1601|sq|1601|sr|1601|su|1601|sv|1601|sw|1601|szl|1601|ta|1601|te|1601|tg|Соли 1601|th|พ.ศ. 2144|tk|1601|tl|1601|tly|1601|tr|1601|tt|1601 ел|uk|1601|ur|1601ء|uz|1601|vec|1601|vi|1601|vls|1601|wa|1601|war|1601|wuu|1601年|xmf|1601|yi|1601|zh|1601年|zh_min_nan|1601 nî|zh_yue|1601年|qid=Q6725}} (Keichō 6)<ref>{{Cite web|和書|url=http://engishiki.org/awa2/bun/awh560703-04.html|title=蛭子神社旧地|publisher=延喜式神社の調査|accessdate=2021-05-11}}</ref>.

In the precincts stand two giant {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=cedar}} trees about 1,000 years old, affectionately called the "Meoto Sugi," along with old trees such as a large {{ill|Camphora officinarum|Q158722|qid=Q158722|lt=ōkusu}} and {{ill|Podocarpus macrophyllus|ar|معلاقة كبيرة الأوراق|arz|معلاقه كبيرة الاوراق|ceb|Podocarpus macrophyllus|de|Großblättrige Steineibe|es|Podocarpus macrophyllus|fr|Podocarpus macrophyllus|hsb|Wulkołopjenaty podokarpus|is|Podocarpus macrophyllus|ja|イヌマキ|ko|나한송|ru|Подокарп крупнолистный|sv|Podocarpus macrophyllus|uk|Podocarpus macrophyllus|vi|Tùng La hán lá dài|war|Podocarpus macrophyllus|zh|羅漢松|zh_yue|羅漢松|qid=Q165063}}. Also within the shrine grounds, {{ill|Luisia teres|ceb|Luisia teres|ja|ボウラン|sv|Luisia teres|vi|Luisia teres|war|Luisia teres|zh|叉唇钗子股|qid=Q10911571}}, designated a Tokushima Prefectural Natural Monument, grows naturally and is best viewed in May<ref>{{Cite web|和書|url=https://www.jalan.net/kankou/spt_36368ag2132025517/|title=蛭子神社|publisher=じゃらん|accessdate=2021-05-11}}</ref>.
